name: Wireless Earbuds
description: True wireless earbuds with active noise cancellation, punchy bass and a pocket-sized charging case.

specs.battery: 6 hours per charge, 30 hours with the case; 10 minutes of charging gives 2 hours of play
specs.noise cancellation: Active noise cancellation up to 30 dB with a transparency mode
specs.water resistance: IPX5, safe against sweat and light rain but not for swimming
specs.connectivity: Bluetooth 5.3, works with Android and iPhone, supports dual pairing

qa: Can I use one earbud at a time?
Yes, either earbud works on its own for calls and music.
Do they have a microphone?
Yes, each earbud has two microphones with noise reduction for calls.

name: Smartwatch
description: A fitness smartwatch with an AMOLED display, built-in GPS and 7-day battery life.

specs.battery: Up to 7 days per charge, 2 hours to charge fully
specs.water resistance: 5 ATM, safe for swimming and showers
specs.gps: Built-in GPS for running and cycling without your phone
specs.connectivity: Bluetooth 5.3, works with Android 8 and above and iOS 14 and above
specs.sensors: Heart rate, SpO2, sleep and stress tracking, 100 sports modes

qa: Can I reply to messages from the watch?
No, you can read notifications but not reply.
Can I make calls on it?
Yes, it supports Bluetooth calling through your phone.

name: Laptop Backpack
description: A 30-litre water-resistant backpack with a padded laptop compartment and a USB charging port.

specs.capacity: 30 litres, fits laptops up to 15.6 inches
specs.water resistance: Water-resistant polyester fabric with a rain cover
specs.material: 600D polyester with padded mesh back panel

qa: Does it fit a 16-inch laptop?
No, the laptop sleeve fits up to 15.6 inches.
Is the USB port powered?
No, it connects your own power bank inside to a phone outside.

name: Bluetooth Speaker
description: A rugged portable speaker with 20 W stereo sound, deep bass and 12-hour battery.

specs.battery: 12 hours of playback, 3 hours to charge
specs.water resistance: IPX7, can be submerged up to 1 metre for 30 minutes
specs.connectivity: Bluetooth 5.3 with 15 metre range, AUX input, pair two speakers for stereo

qa: Does it have a microphone for calls?
Yes, it has a built-in microphone for hands-free calls.

name: Running Shoes
description: Lightweight cushioned running shoes with a breathable mesh upper for daily runs.

specs.material: Breathable knit mesh upper with EVA foam midsole and rubber outsole
specs.care: Hand wash with mild soap; do not machine wash
specs.fit: True to size; choose half a size up for wide feet

qa: Are they good for the gym?
Yes, they work for gym workouts and light training as well as running.

name: Cotton T-shirt
description: A regular-fit crew-neck t-shirt in soft 100 percent combed cotton.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, do not bleach, tumble dry low
specs.fit: Regular fit; size up for a relaxed fit

qa: Does it shrink after washing?
It is pre-shrunk, so shrinkage is under 3 percent when washed cold.

name: Steel Water Bottle
description: A double-wall vacuum insulated stainless steel bottle that keeps drinks hot or cold.

specs.insulation: Keeps drinks cold for 24 hours and hot for 12 hours
specs.care: Hand wash only, not dishwasher safe

qa: Is it leak proof?
Yes, the screw cap has a silicone seal and is leak proof.

name: Phone Case
description: A slim shock-absorbing case with raised edges to protect the camera and screen.

specs.compatibility: Available for iPhone 13 to 16 and Samsung Galaxy S23 and S24

qa: Does it support wireless charging?
Yes, wireless and MagSafe-compatible chargers work through the case.

name: USB-C Charger
description: A compact 33 W GaN fast charger with a USB-C cable.

specs.power: 33 W output with Power Delivery and Quick Charge fast charging
specs.compatibility: Works with USB-C phones, tablets, earbuds and small laptops
specs.in the box: Charger and 1 metre USB-C to USB-C cable

qa: Can it charge a laptop?
It can charge small laptops that accept 30 W USB-C charging, but slowly.
Will it fast charge an iPhone?
Yes, with a USB-C to Lightning or USB-C cable it fast charges iPhone 8 and newer.

name: Desk Lamp
description: An LED desk lamp with touch controls, 5 colour temperatures and eye-care flicker-free light.

specs.power: 10 W LED, plugs into a USB-C adapter
specs.features: Touch controls, 60-minute auto-off timer, foldable arm

qa: Does it run on battery?
No, it needs to be plugged in.

name: Yoga Mat
description: A 6 mm thick non-slip yoga mat with a carry strap.

specs.material: Eco-friendly TPE, free of latex and PVC

qa: Is it slippery when sweaty?
No, both sides have a textured non-slip grip.

name: Coffee Mug Set
description: A set of four 350 ml ceramic coffee mugs.

name: Over-ear Headphones
description: Wireless over-ear headphones with hybrid noise cancellation and 50-hour battery.

specs.battery: 50 hours with noise cancellation off, 35 hours with it on
specs.noise cancellation: Hybrid active noise cancellation up to 40 dB
specs.connectivity: Bluetooth 5.3 and a 3.5 mm wired option, multipoint pairing
specs.charging: USB-C fast charging, 10 minutes gives 5 hours

qa: Can I use them with a wire?
Yes, a 3.5 mm audio cable is included.
Are they foldable?
Yes, the ear cups fold flat into the carry case.

name: Neckband Earphones
description: Bluetooth neckband earphones with magnetic buds and 30-hour battery.

specs.battery: 30 hours of playback, 10 minutes of charging gives 10 hours

name: Fitness Band
description: A slim fitness band that tracks steps, heart rate and sleep with a 14-day battery.

specs.sensors: Heart rate, SpO2, steps, sleep tracking
specs.gps: No built-in GPS; it uses your phone's GPS

name: Power Bank
description: A 20,000 mAh power bank with 22.5 W fast charging and three outputs.

specs.capacity: 20,000 mAh, charges a phone about 4 times
specs.power: 22.5 W fast charging output, 18 W input

qa: Can I carry it on a plane?
Yes, 20,000 mAh is within airline limits for cabin baggage, but not checked baggage.

name: Laptop Sleeve
description: A padded, water-resistant laptop sleeve with a front accessory pocket.

specs.material: Water-resistant neoprene with soft fleece lining

name: Electric Kettle
description: A 1.5 litre stainless steel electric kettle with automatic shut-off.

specs.power: 1500 W, boils 1 litre in about 4 minutes

name: Air Fryer
description: A 4.2 litre digital air fryer that fries, bakes and grills with up to 85 percent less oil.

specs.features: 8 presets, digital touch panel, 60-minute timer, temperature 80 to 200 °C

qa: Does it need oil?
No, most foods need little or no oil; a teaspoon helps with crispiness.

name: Dumbbell Set
description: An adjustable dumbbell set from 2 to 10 kg per hand with a carry case.

specs.weight: Adjustable from 2 to 10 kg per dumbbell, 20 kg total
specs.material: Cast iron plates with PVC coating and knurled steel handles

name: Resistance Bands
description: A set of 5 latex resistance bands from light to extra heavy.

name: Hoodie
description: A warm fleece-lined pullover hoodie with a kangaroo pocket.

specs.material: 80 percent cotton, 20 percent polyester fleece, 320 GSM

name: Track Pants
description: Slim-fit stretchable track pants with zip pockets.

name: Wireless Mouse
description: A silent-click wireless mouse with Bluetooth and USB receiver.

specs.battery: Up to 12 months on one AA battery
specs.connectivity: Bluetooth 5.0 and 2.4 GHz USB receiver, works with Windows, macOS and Android

name: Mechanical Keyboard
description: A compact 75 percent wireless mechanical keyboard with hot-swappable switches and RGB backlight.

specs.connectivity: Bluetooth, 2.4 GHz and wired USB-C; works with Windows and macOS
specs.battery: 4000 mAh, about 2 weeks with backlight off

name: Webcam
description: A 1080p webcam with dual microphones and a privacy shutter.

specs.resolution: 1080p at 30 fps with auto light correction
specs.connectivity: Plug and play USB, works with Zoom, Teams and Google Meet
specs.features: Privacy shutter and dual noise-reducing microphones

name: Bedsheet Set
description: A 100 percent cotton bedsheet with two pillow covers.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, colours do not bleed

name: Sunglasses
description: Polarised wayfarer sunglasses with UV400 protection and a hard case.
